candidates.description: Inspect data directory entries and metadata after the update.
Inspect the north workers value and its parsed JSON type.
candidates.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
data = json.loads(Path('/app/data/services.json').read_text())
workers = data['services']['north']['workers']
print('north workers:', workers)
print('Python type:', type(workers).__name__)
print('revision:', data['revision'])
PY
